description:
Current U.S. market backdrop in one call: market regime (calm uptrend / uptrend under stress / downtrend / panic /
recovery, from the S&P 500 trend and VIX), VIX level and percentile, Fed funds rate, 2y and 10y Treasury yields,
yield-curve shape, and the next Fed (FOMC) meetings with days until each and the market-implied odds of a cut,
hold or hike. Use for 'what's the market backdrop?', 'when is the next Fed meeting?', 'odds of a rate cut?'.
